hints.title: Count Conflicting Positions
hints.text: Identify all indices i where nums[i] == forbidden[i].

hints.title: Frequency Majority Check
hints.text: If any conflicting value appears in more than half the conflicting positions, it cannot be completely resolved among conflicting indices alone.

hints.title: Pairwise Resolving Swaps
hints.text: Pairs of conflicts with distinct values can be resolved with one swap. Compute the ceiling of total conflicts divided by 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass conflict identification and counting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of nums is factorial O(n!).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects conflict pigeonhole analysis and pairwise swap resolution.
